scientific_integrity.claim_domain: Independent uniformly sampled distinct-type offers; one minimum-multiplicity coupon retained per round; first complete set; proportional offer size bounded away from both endpoints.
scientific_integrity.computational_support: 598 standalone finite assertions using exact fractions and Python decimal; analytic proof required for infinite claims.
limitations: No conclusions for vanishing or full offer fractions, multi-copy targets, or nonuniform dependent offers.
The sharp first-order probability correction is shown along fixed rational offer fractions, not arbitrary rounded sequences.
Historical priority remains provisional; classical q-distribution identities are credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_integrity.proof_dependencies: Exact independent geometric phases, hypergeometric product bounds, monotone geometric coupling, q-binomial coefficient identity, dominated first-order expansion.

title: An Euler-product limit and sharp convergence rate for proportional-choice coupon collection
